items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Then I had Amos Riley with us on the car in the Arlene Creole Jazz Band. Had him with us in there.

ctx.x: Don't want to turn it off a minute if you want to. No, that's not bothering me.
Just my footmark. That's with my band. After my band broke up, then they grabbed me on the counter, you know, blind Freddie.
